names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 24 noiembrie, «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Clement, Episcopul Romei», with the rank words and the see left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 24 Νοεμβρίου, «Άγιος Κλήμης Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Ρώμης», with the rank words and the see left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 25. новембар ст. ст., „Свешт. муч. Климент еп. Римски.“ — «Свешт. муч.» is Свештеномученик, the `hieromartyr` grade this folder already keeps, and «еп.» is епископ, the `bishop` grade it also keeps, so both rank words come off. «Римски» is KEPT, and the keeping is a reading and not a rule: it is the see adjective, the folder’s `office` is already Bishop of Rome, and the bare «Климент» measured before this was written stands on three other folders — `clement-apostle-of-sardis`, `clement-of-ancyra` and `clement-of-ohrid` — so the bare forename would have made a four-member fold out of a form the book itself does not oblige. The fuller form stands on no other folder and joins no fold. This is the practice the corpus already carries in «Пафнутије Боровски» and «Матрона Цариградска».

attestations.note: Not checked: days.pravoslavie.ru for the corresponding Julian day (25 September 2026).

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 24 noiembrie — «Sfântul Sfințit Mucenic Clement, Episcopul Romei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 24ης Νοεμβρίου — «Άγιος Κλήμης Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Ρώμης»

attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/3000/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Νοεμβρίου εκάστου έτους» and «Αγιος Κλημης Ιερομαρτυρας, Επισκοπος Ρωμης (; - 101)», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: the third bishop of Rome, drowned with an anchor at his neck near Cherson. A death interval is proposed from the page's own year where the folder had none. The two hymns taken are shared with `peter-of-alexandria`, the other hierarch of this day: both name Clement and Peter and no other saint, and both carry an ἦχος and a model, so both are drafted onto both folders. The page's first Ἀπολυτίκιον, «Ὁ Θεὸς τῶν Πατέρων ἠμῶν», is the common of fathers and carries neither tone nor model on this page, and the Οἶκος and the Κάθισμα are neither a troparion nor a kontakion, so none of the three is drafted. The page adds relics at the Lavra of the Caves at Kyiv, at Inkerman near Sevastopol, at the Roman Catholic basilica of Saint Peter in Rome and at the Petraki monastery in Athens. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 08.12.2025 (25. новембар ст. ст.) — „Свешт. муч. Климент еп. Римски.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry. THE DAY IS NOT THE ONE THE OTHER TWO CALENDARS KEEP: the Romanian and the Greek both hold him on 24 November and this book holds him on the Julian 25 November, one menologion number later, and the two days are recorded as they stand because the Serbian row is this folder’s first and nothing was moved to reach it. `dates` UNTOUCHED: the book drowns him «101. године», which is exactly the 101 this folder already holds from saint.gr. TWO `related` ROWS ADDED, both halves of one: the book makes the apostle Barnabas the first man he found at Alexandria on the search for his family, and this folder had no row to him. NOT ADDED, and a line for the author: the book sets out the Roman succession as Peter, then Linus, then Cletus, then Clement, and the corpus keeps a `linus-of-rome`; a see held one after another is not plainly a relation between two men in this corpus’s sense and no row was written either way. WHAT THE ENTRY ADDS: his birth at Rome of the imperial house and his being a contemporary of the apostles; the storm that carried his mother and his two brothers to different lands and the father lost looking for them; his own setting out east at twenty-four to find them; his two brothers Faustinus and Faustinianus, already following the apostle, whom the corpus does not keep; the mother found as an old beggar woman and the father after her, and the whole house reunited and returned to Rome Christian; the seven swift writers he appointed to write the lives of the martyrs; Trajan’s sentence of exile to Cherson and the two thousand Christians he found there hewing stone in a waterless place; the water brought out of the earth by his prayer and the seventy-five churches raised there in one year; the stone about his neck; AND THE RELICS BROUGHT UP OUT OF THE SEA ONLY IN THE TIME OF CYRIL AND METHODIUS, to both of whom this folder is already related both ways.

hymns.text: Dumnezeul părinţilor noştri Care faci pururea cu noi după blândeţile Tale, nu îndepărta mila Ta de la noi; ci, pentru rugăciunile lor, în pace îndreptează viaţa noastră.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Clement, Episcopul Romei, și al Sfântului Sfințit Mucenic Petru (the common «Dumnezeul părinţilor noştri», printed for the two of them together)

english.text: O God of our fathers, who deal with us always according to your gentleness, take not your mercy from us; but by their prayers guide our life in peace.

hymns.text: Tῆς θείας γνώσεως εὔσημοι σάλπιγγες καὶ τῶν τῆς πίστεως θεσμῶν ἐκφάντωρες ἱερομάρτυρες Χριστοῦ ἐδείχθητε τοῖς ἐν κόσμῳ, Κλήμη παναοίδιμε, τῆς ζωῆς κλῆμα εὔκαρπον καὶ Πέτρε θεόσοφε, εὐσεβῶν πέτρα ἄρρηκτε· διὸ ὡς τῶν ἀρρήτων ἐπόπται, ῥύσασθαι πάσης ἡμᾶς βλάβης.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος γ’, Τὴν ὡραιότητα — on the page of «Άγιος Κλήμης Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Ρώμης», and the same text stands on the page of «Άγιος Πέτρος Ιερομάρτυρας Αρχιεπίσκοπος Αλεξανδρείας». It names the two of them and no other saint, playing on both names — Clement the fruitful vine-branch, κλῆμα, and Peter the unbroken rock, πέτρα. The initial Latin T of «Tῆς» is the page's own.

english.text: Clear-sounding trumpets of the knowledge of God and declarers of the ordinances of the faith, you were shown to those in the world as hieromartyrs of Christ — Clement of all renown, the fruitful vine-branch of life, and Peter of God's wisdom, the unbroken rock of the godly. Therefore, as beholders of things unspeakable, deliver us from every harm.

hymns.text: Ἐκκλησίας ἄσειστοι, καὶ θεῖοι πύργοι, εὐσεβείας ἔνθεοι, στῦλοι ὡς ὄντες κραταιοί, Κλήμη σὺν Πέτρω πανεύφημοι, ὑμῶν πρεσβείαις, φρουρεῖτε τοὺς ἅπαντας.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον — on the page of «Άγιος Κλήμης Ιερομάρτυρας, επίσκοπος Ρώμης», and the same text stands on the page of «Άγιος Πέτρος Ιερομάρτυρας Αρχιεπίσκοπος Αλεξανδρείας». It names the two of them and no other saint.

english.text: Unshaken and divine towers of the Church, godly pillars of piety, being strong as you are — Clement with Peter, all-praised — guard us all by your intercessions.

death.note: saint.gr heads the page «Αγιος Κλημης Ιερομαρτυρας, Επισκοπος Ρωμης (; - 101)» and the narrative closes with it: «έδεσαν στο λαιμό του μια σιδερένεια άγκυρα και τον έριξαν στη θάλασσα, όπου παρέδωσε την αγία ψυχή του (101 μ.Χ)». The page gives no year of birth; the year 92 it gives for his accession to Rome is not a date of his life and is not recorded as one.
